t: Welcome to Blind World Hub
d: Blind World Hub is now online: accessible apps, guides and videos for blind and visually impaired people, in one place.

t: About Blind World Hub
d: Blind World Hub is run by Waqas, a blind YouTube creator who shares accessible apps, guides and video reviews for blind and visually impaired people.

t: Accessibility statement
d: Blind World Hub is built for screen reader users and aims to meet WCAG 2.2 level AA.

t: Contact
d: Contact Blind World Hub through its WhatsApp community or YouTube channel to ask a question, suggest an app or report a problem.

t: Disclaimer and copyright
d: Apps on Blind World Hub are shared as they are. Owners who want an app removed can contact us.

t: Privacy policy
d: Blind World Hub does not collect personal data. It has no accounts, no tracking and no advertising.
